subject.title: [Feishu] 飞书群多机器人身份混乱问题

question: Should Feishu multi-account group sessions become account/app-scoped by default, and what migration or compatibility path should existing accountless group sessions receive?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the likely fix changes durable session identity across message delivery, session state, and account authorization boundaries.

options.title: Scope Group Sessions By Account/App
options.body: Make Feishu group session identity include the stable account/app boundary and add migration or doctor handling for existing group sessions.

options.title: Add Opt-In Isolation
options.body: Keep existing shared group sessions by default and add an explicit Feishu account-scoped mode for multi-bot deployments.

options.title: Defer To Broader Feishu Identity Work
options.body: Keep this issue open until a wider multi-bot Feishu routing and session design settles mention, DM, and group identity together.

recommendation.title: Scope Group Sessions By Account/App
recommendation.body: Make Feishu group session identity include the stable account/app boundary and add migration or doctor handling for existing group sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu and routing history makes this the strongest available owner for the account-scoped group session decision.
